title: Verified Changes document (verified-changes/0.1)
description: A dated, sourced list of changes to published facts. Specification: https://databutler.dev/protocol. The document is what the JSON endpoint and the MCP tool what_changed_since return; a publisher may also serve it as a static file. Extra top-level properties (a response envelope, the query that produced the document) are allowed.

schema.description: URL of the JSON Schema this document validates against (this file).

generated.description: The day this document was produced.

since.description: The since filter applied, if any.

coverageStart.description: Changes before this day are not itemised.

entry.title: Verified change entry
entry.description: One fact that moved. Identity is area + key + verifiedDate; entries are never edited after publication — a correction is a new entry.

area.description: Dataset area slug, one of the publisher's declared areas.

key.description: Stable identifier of the fact within its area, slash-separated (e.g. income-tax/personal-allowance). The same fact keeps the same key forever.

from.description: The previous value, any JSON value. null means the fact is new.

to.description: The new value, any JSON value. null means the fact was withdrawn.

effectiveFrom.description: The day the new value applies from, per the source; null when the source does not date it.

source.description: The official page the change was verified against.

verifiedDate.description: The day the publisher fetched the source and confirmed the value.

note.description: Maintainer context (which Budget, which spec update); may be empty.

unit.description: Unit of from/to when numeric, e.g. GBP/year, %.
